title: Accepted changes are production-ready; approved changes converge to main (no invented release states)
context: During PL-PROV-FAILOVER a temporary experiment branch was created; this was recognized as inconsistent with the Principal's delivery philosophy.
evidence_at_time: Experiment branch existed alongside accepted commit 097844f; branch deleted after accepted commit reached origin/main.
alternatives: keep approved code on special branches ('approved but not main', 'safety copy', 'experiment version', 'production candidate')
principal_wording: Every accepted change is intended to be production-ready. Environments provide progressively stronger evidence of readiness; they do not provide progressively weaker definitions of done.
rationale: Deployment safety comes from verification, immutable artifact identity, rollback, and recovery — not from keeping approved code on special branches.
expected_consequences: main remains deployable; immutable artifacts move through staging/production.
implementation: Temporary experiment remote branch deleted (j2:38, j2:511).
subsequent: The preferred model listed a PR/review boundary. The later Principal Git workflow (steering) forbids routine PRs, branches and worktrees and commits directly to main after acceptance.
amendments: Partially superseded on PR usage by current development-workflow steering; see SJ2-E004.
notes: Not in ADR-001–023.

title: Exploration does not authorize implementation; separate exploration and verification loops
context: Codex had displaced speculative architecture conversation into implementation-review mode.

rationale: Codex is most valuable as a falsifier after something concrete exists to inspect.
expected_consequences: Exploration loop Principal↔Kiro↔ChatGPT has no implementation authority; verification loop Kiro→Codex→ChatGPT→Principal.
subsequent: Three-AI contract 2026-09-14 (j3:534-594) assigns ChatGPT=Architect, Kiro=Implementation Engineer, Codex=Reviewer.
notes: Labelled 'Durable rule' but no ratifier named.

title: Do not optimize provider concurrency absent new evidence; move optimization to evidence-value allocation

expected_consequences: Future work asks which evidence deserves scarce capacity (PL-EVID-AGE / G6-N1).
subsequent: Current-investigation steering (Doc 40, 2026-08-31 data) records that the old path underutilized the allowance at about 75/min. The two evidence sets come from different configs and dates.
